questions.question: A boat takes 18 minutes to go 59.4 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream is 3 : 2. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 29.3 km upstream and 51.5 km downstream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Upstream Speed (U) = 59.4 km ÷ (18/60) h = 198 kmph.

Ratio of Still Water (u) to Stream (v) = 3 : 2 ⇒ Upstream ratio (u−v) = 3 − 2 = 1 unit.

1 unit = 198 kmph ⇒ u = 3 × 198 = 594 kmph, v = 2 × 198 = 396 kmph.

Downstream Speed (D) = u + v = 5 unit = 5 × 198 = 990 kmph.

Total Time = (29.3 ÷ 198) + (51.5 ÷ 990) ≈ 0.148 + 0.052 = 0.2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7d7d4aa96bdf98c7cf772b56ecdcdd382ae774455f0a7a59db9293647a76f9b.png] 

**Given:** Upstream Distance = 59.4 km, Time = 18 min = 0.3 hours. Ratio u : v = 3 : 2.

**Formula Used:** Speed = Distance ÷ Time; Upstream Speed (U) = u − v; Downstream Speed (D) = u + v.

⇒ Upstream Speed (U) = 59.4 ÷ 0.3 = 198 kmph.

⇒ Let u = 3x and v = 2x. Then U = 3x − 2x = x.

⇒ x = 198 kmph.

⇒ Downstream Speed (D) = 3x + 2x = 5x = 5 × 198 = 990 kmph.

⇒ Time for 29.3 km Upstream = 29.3 ÷ 198 ≈ 0.14798 hours.

⇒ Time for 51.5 km Downstream = 51.5 ÷ 990 ≈ 0.05202 hours.

⇒ Total Time = 0.14798 + 0.05202 = 0.2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Water

Upstream Speed = Speed of boat (u) − Speed of stream (v). Downstream Speed = Speed of boat (u) + Speed of stream (v).

Still Water and Stream Speed Formulas

Speed of boat in still water (u) = (Downstream + Upstream) ÷ 2. Speed of stream (v) = (Downstream − Upstream) ÷ 2.

Time, Speed, Distance Relation

Time = Distance ÷ Speed. Ensure all units are consistent (e.g., km and hours or m and seconds) before calculation.</p

questions.question: A bike can finish a certain journey in 6 hours at the speed of 92 km/hr. In order to cover the same distance in 3 hours, the speed of the bike (in km/hr) must be increased by ____.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Time ratio** (Initial : New) = 6 : 3 = 2 : 1

Since **Distance** is constant, **Speed ratio** is inverse of **Time ratio** = 1 : 2

1 unit (Initial Speed) = 92 km/hr

**Increase in speed** required = 2 − 1 = 1 unit = 92 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 92 km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial Speed = 92 km/hr, Initial Time = 6 hours, New Time = 3 hours

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe21668f6e9dc701a4940f53846a01fb4b7e8ee437ea7166fb5704d17423f084.png] 

⇒ **Total Distance** = 92 km/hr × 6 hours

⇒ **Total Distance** = 552 km

⇒ **Required New Speed** = Total Distance ÷ New Time

⇒ **New Speed** = 552 ÷ 3 = 184 km/hr

⇒ **Increase in Speed** = New Speed − Initial Speed

⇒ **Increase in Speed** = 184 − 92 = 92 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 92 km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Inverse Variation Rule

When distance is constant, speed and time are inversely proportional (S₁ × T₁ = S₂ × T₂).

Average Speed

If a journey is covered in two equal distances at speeds x and y, average speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

Speed of two objects moving in the same direction is (S₁ − S₂) and in opposite directions is (S₁ + S₂).</p

questions.question: A bike can finish a certain journey in 20 hours at the speed of 66 km/hr. In order to cover the same distance in 15 hours, the speed of the bike (in km/hr) must be increased by
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Since **Distance** is constant, **Speed** is inversely proportional to **Time** (S ∝ 1/T).

Time ratio (Initial : New) = 20 : 15 = 4 : 3

Speed ratio (Initial : New) = 3 : 4

Given initial speed 3 units = 66 km/hr → 1 unit = 22 km/hr.

**Speed increase** = New − Initial = 4 − 3 = 1 unit = 22 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 22 km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Speed (S₁) = 66 km/hr, Initial Time (T₁) = 20 hours, New Time (T₂) = 15 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Distance (D) = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc8f423e33cdfab240d7d8f675da3b2d7bebbc06512ae7e1fa47d0cde87a147d.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance = S₁ × T₁

⇒ Distance = 66 × 20 = 1320 km

⇒ Required New Speed (S₂) = Distance ÷ T₂

⇒ S₂ = 1320 ÷ 15 = 88 km/hr

⇒ Increase in speed = S₂ − S₁

⇒ Increase = 88 − 66 = 22 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 22 km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Inverse Variation in Speed and Time

When the distance to be covered is constant, the ratio of speeds is the **reciprocal** of the ratio of time taken: S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁.

Average Speed Formula

For a round trip or same distance covered at two different speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: A man has to cover a distance of 549 km in 8 hours. If he covers (2)/(3)of this distance in (3)/(4)of the time, then what should be his speed (in km/hr) to cover the remaining distance in the time left?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__
Remaining distance = (1 − 2/3) × 549 = 1/3 × 549 = 183 km.

Remaining time = (1 − 3/4) × 8 = 1/4 × 8 = 2 hours.

Required Speed = Remaining Distance ÷ Remaining Time = 183 ÷ 2 = 91.5 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 91.5 km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total distance = 549 km, Total time = 8 hours.

**Formula Used:** Speed = Distance ÷ Time
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa0ae280174d836288683ee7ba73e1bc3fca35bf9c89d8d7e01eb9c75490fe0d.png] 
⇒ **Distance covered** = 2/3 × 549 = 366 km

⇒ **Remaining distance** = 549 − 366 = 183 km

⇒ **Time taken** = 3/4 × 8 = 6 hours

⇒ **Remaining time** = 8 − 6 = 2 hours

⇒ **Required Speed** = 183 ÷ 2 = 91.5 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 91.5 km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If distances are equal, Average Speed = 2xy/(x+y).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed

Same direction = S₁ − S₂ | Opposite direction = S₁ + S₂.</p

questions.question: A byke travels 80 km at the speed of 40 km/hr and the next 45 km at the speed of 15 km/hr. What is its average speed (in km/hr)?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__
**Average Speed** = **Total Distance** ÷ **Total Time**

Time 1 = 80 ÷ 40 = 2 hours

Time 2 = 45 ÷ 15 = 3 hours

Average Speed = (80 + 45) ÷ (2 + 3) = 125 ÷ 5 = 25 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 25 km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance₁ (d₁) = 80 km, Speed₁ (s₁) = 40 km/hr

Distance₂ (d₂) = 45 km, Speed₂ (s₂) = 15 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = (Total Distance) ÷ (Total Time)
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62d82559a7f63e1ccf3f8b0c1acf32d0d7f723cf099766f1e198131da2f47c29.png] 
⇒ Total Distance = 80 + 45 = 125 km

⇒ Time taken for first part (t₁) = 80 ÷ 40 = 2 hours

⇒ Time taken for second part (t₂) = 45 ÷ 15 = 3 hours

⇒ Total Time = 2 + 3 = 5 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 125 ÷ 5 = 25 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 25 km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Equal Distance Case

If a journey covers two equal distances at speeds u and v, then Average Speed = (2 × u × v) ÷ (u + v).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed is the difference of their speeds. In opposite directions, it is the sum.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: A boat takes 90 minutes to go 49.2 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream is 3 : 2. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 44.8 km upstream and 71.2 km downstream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Upstream speed** (U) = 49.2 ÷ 1.5 = 32.8 kmph.

Ratio of **Speed in still water** (x) : **Speed of stream** (y) = 3 : 2.

Upstream ratio (x − y) = 3 − 2 = 1 unit → 32.8 kmph.

Downstream ratio (x + y) = 3 + 2 = 5 units → 5 × 32.8 = 164 kmph.

Total time = (44.8 ÷ 32.8) + (71.2 ÷ 164) = 1.365 + 0.434 ≈ 1.8 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.8 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f036f2de68c2d6989d0e7ab7d83ca4339a9f8d6c30a2ffcf6e1abde3cc6d7cd0.png] 

**Given:**

Distance Upstream₁ = 49.2 km, Time₁ = 90 min = 1.5 hours.

Ratio of **Speed of Boat** (x) to **Stream** (y) = 3 : 2.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed Upstream (U) = Distance ÷ Time = 49.2 ÷ 1.5 = 32.8 kmph.

⇒ Let x = 3k and y = 2k. Then U = x − y = 3k − 2k = k.

⇒ k = 32.8 kmph.

⇒ Speed Downstream (D) = x + y = 3k + 2k = 5k = 5 × 32.8 = 164 kmph.

⇒ Time for 44.8 km Upstream = 44.8 ÷ 32.8 = 1.3658... hours.

⇒ Time for 71.2 km Downstream = 71.2 ÷ 164 = 0.4341... hours.

⇒ Total Time = 1.3658 + 0.4341 = 1.7999... ≈ 1.8 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.8 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Water

Upstream Speed = Speed of Boat (x) − Speed of Stream (y). Downstream Speed = x + y.

Conversion of Time

To convert **minutes to hours**, divide the value by 60. Example: 90 min = 90/60 = 1.5 hours.

Calculating x and y from U and D

Speed of Boat in Still Water (x) = (D + U) ÷ 2 and Speed of Stream (y) = (D − U) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: One-third of a journey is covered at a speed of 31 km/hr, the next one-third of the journey is covered at a speed of 4 km/hr, and the remaining journey is covered at a speed of 34 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to one decimal place) for the entire journey is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When equal distances (1/3 each) are covered at speeds **x**, **y**, and **z**, the **Average Speed** is given by the formula: **3xyz / (xy + yz + zx)**.

Average Speed = (3 × 31 × 4 × 34) ÷ (31 × 4 + 4 × 34 + 34 × 31)

Average Speed = 12648 ÷ (124 + 136 + 1054) = 12648 ÷ 1314

Average Speed ≈ 9.625 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 9.6 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/662a9a877a24d574fdf1874492c7e60505b4d705627c2b08a714879179b95850.png] 

**Given:** Speeds v₁ = 31 km/hr, v₂ = 4 km/hr, v₃ = 34 km/hr. Let the total distance be **D**. Each segment is **D/3**.

**Formula:** Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Total Time = (D/3 ÷ 31) + (D/3 ÷ 4) + (D/3 ÷ 34)

⇒ Total Time = (D/3) × [1/31 + 1/4 + 1/34]

⇒ Total Time = (D/3) × [(136 + 1054 + 124) ÷ 4216] = (D/3) × [1314 ÷ 4216]

⇒ Average Speed = D ÷ [(D × 1314) ÷ 12648]

⇒ Average Speed = 12648 ÷ 1314 ≈ 9.625 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 9.6 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Two Equal Distances

When two equal distances are covered at speeds **u** and **v**, the average speed is 2uv / (u + v).

General Average Speed Formula

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. This is applicable for all scenarios including unequal distances or time intervals.

Rounding Off Rules

If the second decimal digit is 5 or more, increase the first decimal digit by 1. Here, 9.625 is rounded to 9.6 as 2 < 5.</p

questions.question: A train is 1495 m and it crosses a platform in 2.8 minutes running at the speed of 54 km/hr. Find the difference between the length of the train and the platform.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert **speed**: 54 km/hr × 5/18 = 15 m/s.

Convert **time**: 2.8 minutes × 60 = 168 seconds.

**Total Distance** (Train + Platform) = 15 × 168 = 2520 m.

**Platform Length** = 2520 − 1495 = 1025 m.

**Difference** = 1495 − 1025 = 470 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 470 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length of Train** (L₁) = 1495 m

**Speed of Train** (S) = 54 km/hr

**Time taken** (t) = 2.8 minutes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f309b7c955f57a4c00817c8bc0267b9ff3c881b9d79e77be1f6905c490c4c51.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Total Distance = Length of Train + Length of Platform

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed in m/s = 54 × (5/18) = 15 m/s

⇒ Time in seconds = 2.8 × 60 = 168 seconds

⇒ Total Distance = 15 × 168 = 2520 m

⇒ Length of Platform = 2520 − 1495 = 1025 m

⇒ Difference = 1495 − 1025 = 470 m

**∴ The correct answer is 470 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂. In the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|.

Train Crossing Objects

When a train crosses a stationary pole/man, distance = length of train. When it crosses a bridge/platform, distance = length of train + length of object.</p

questions.question: A man takes 13 hours to swim 91 km downstream. He swims 39 km upstream in the same time. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Downstream speed (D) = 91 ÷ 13 = 7 km/hr

Upstream speed (U) = 39 ÷ 13 = 3 km/hr

Speed of boat in still water = (D + U) ÷ 2 = (7 + 3) ÷ 2 = 5 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 5 km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dadcd20c213dd68eb1a2c6b89a3a1bd1527d6ac333cf327cf8e7461174c1b18e.png] 

**Given:**

Downstream Distance = 91 km, Upstream Distance = 39 km, Time = 13 hours

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed of boat (u) = (Downstream speed + Upstream speed) ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream speed (v + s) = 91 ÷ 13 = 7 km/hr

⇒ Upstream speed (v − s) = 39 ÷ 13 = 3 km/hr

⇒ Adding both equations: 2v = 7 + 3

⇒ 2v = 10

⇒ v = 5 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 5 km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Speed of Stream

The speed of the current or stream is calculated as (Downstream speed − Upstream speed) ÷ 2.

Average Speed in Still Water

If a boat travels the same distance downstream and upstream, the average speed in still water is the arithmetic mean of the two speeds.

Relative Speed in Water

Downstream speed = Speed of boat + Speed of stream. Upstream speed = Speed of boat − Speed of stream.</p

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 17 km/hr and the speed of the stream is 16 km/hr. A man rows to a place at a distance of 26.4 km and comes back to the starting point. Find the total time (in hours) taken by him.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Downstream Speed** (D) = 17 + 16 = 33 km/hr

**Upstream Speed** (U) = 17 − 16 = 1 km/hr

**Total Time** = (Distance ÷ D) + (Distance ÷ U)

**Total Time** = (26.4 ÷ 33) + (26.4 ÷ 1) = 0.8 + 26.4 = 27.2 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 27.2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/122dcf05a69d6c330b9838efd12a0daedae175ee9adeab3c05f58b81b8a1c18e.png] 

**Given:**

**Speed of boat** (u) = 17 km/hr

**Speed of stream** (v) = 16 km/hr

**Distance** (d) = 26.4 km

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Downstream Speed = u + v

Upstream Speed = u − v

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream Speed = 17 + 16 = 33 km/hr

⇒ Upstream Speed = 17 − 16 = 1 km/hr

⇒ Time taken downstream (t₁) = 26.4 ÷ 33 = 0.8 hours

⇒ Time taken upstream (t₂) = 26.4 ÷ 1 = 26.4 hours

⇒ Total Time = t₁ + t₂ = 0.8 + 26.4 = 27.2 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 27.2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Downstream Speed

When the boat moves in the direction of the stream, its effective speed is the sum of the boat speed and stream speed (u + v).

Upstream Speed

When the boat moves against the direction of the stream, its effective speed is the difference between the boat speed and stream speed (u − v).

Average Speed for Round Trip

The average speed for a boat going to a point and returning is given by: Average Speed = (Downstream Speed × Upstream Speed) ÷ Speed of Boat in Still Water.</p

questions.question: A man takes 6 hours to swim 66 km downstream. He swims 42 km upstream in the same time. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Downstream Speed (D)** = 66 ÷ 6 = 11 km/hr

**Upstream Speed (U)** = 42 ÷ 6 = 7 km/hr

**Speed in Still Water** = (D + U) ÷ 2 = (11 + 7) ÷ 2 = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 9 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd7d384f2f47019d19a8bdbd00c540e8c42857828557db89bca3285cb2300999.png] 

**Given:**

Downstream Distance = 66 km, Upstream Distance = 42 km, Time = 6 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed in Still Water (x) = (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed) ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream Speed (D) = 66 / 6 = 11 km/hr

⇒ Upstream Speed (U) = 42 / 6 = 7 km/hr

⇒ Speed of boat in still water (x) = (11 + 7) ÷ 2

⇒ x = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 9 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Current

The speed of the stream or current (y) can be calculated as y = (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed) ÷ 2.

Relative Speed in Water

Downstream speed = Boat speed + Stream speed (x + y). Upstream speed = Boat speed − Stream speed (x − y).

Average Speed for Round Trip

If a boat travels the same distance downstream and upstream, Average Speed = (D × U) ÷ Boat Speed in still water.</p

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 12 km/hr and the speed of the stream is 10 km/hr. A man rows to a place at a distance of 24.2 km and comes back to the starting point. Find the total time (in hours) taken by him.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Downstream speed** (u + v) = 12 + 10 = 22 km/hr

**Upstream speed** (u − v) = 12 − 10 = 2 km/hr

Total time = (Distance ÷ Downstream speed) + (Distance ÷ Upstream speed)

Total time = (24.2 ÷ 22) + (24.2 ÷ 2) = 1.1 + 12.1 = 13.2 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 13.2 hours.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of boat in still water (u) = 12 km/hr

Speed of stream (v) = 10 km/hr

Distance (D) = 24.2 km

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Downstream speed = u + v

Upstream speed = u − v

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8728a59fe50035a7efdd68d192e5e5c855af82c818e9f4ae9c122aa8e1d8083a.png] 

⇒ Downstream Speed = 12 + 10 = 22 km/hr

⇒ Upstream Speed = 12 − 10 = 2 km/hr

⇒ Time taken going Downstream = 24.2 ÷ 22 = 1.1 hours

⇒ Time taken coming Upstream = 24.2 ÷ 2 = 12.1 hours

⇒ Total Time = 1.1 + 12.1 = 13.2 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 13.2 hours.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed in Boats and Streams

When the distance is same for both ways, Average Speed = (Downstream Speed × Upstream Speed) ÷ Still Water Speed.

Still Water Speed Calculation

Speed in still water (u) = 1/2 × (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed).

Stream Speed Calculation

Speed of stream (v) = 1/2 × (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed).</p

questions.question: A woman travelled at a speed of 20 m/min for 80 min, and at a speed of 65 m/min for 64 min. Her average speed (in m/min) is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **time** = 80 : 64 = 5 : 4

**Weighted Average Speed** = [(Speed₁ × Time Ratio₁) + (Speed₂ × Time Ratio₂)] ÷ Total Ratio

Average Speed = [(20 × 5) + (65 × 4)] ÷ (5 + 4)

Average Speed = [100 + 260] ÷ 9 = 360 ÷ 9 = 40 m/min

**∴ The correct answer is 40 m/min.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed₁ = 20 m/min, Time₁ = 80 min

Speed₂ = 65 m/min, Time₂ = 64 min

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac14c49a268f314f1ded47c51728c87a1c8b38aa73ca96197dc11e6a8cad740f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance₁ = 20 × 80 = 1600 m

⇒ Distance₂ = 65 × 64 = 4160 m

questions.question: A boat takes 39 minutes to go 27.9 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream is 9 : 4. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 18.9 km upstream and 51.3 km downstream?

Since 5k = 42.92, k = 8.584. U = 42.92, D = 13 × 8.584 = 111.592.

Time = (18.9 ÷ 42.92) + (51.3 ÷ 111.592) ≈ 0.44 + 0.46 = 0.9 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.9 hours.**

⇒ 3T = 39

⇒ T = 13 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 13 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion of Speed and Time

When the **distance** is constant, the time taken is inversely proportional to the speed (T ∝ 1/S). If speed becomes 1/n times, time becomes n times.

Late/Early Concept Formula

Distance = [ (S₁ × S₂) / |S₁ − S₂| ] × Difference in time. This is useful for finding the actual distance between two points.</p

questions.question: A boat takes 27 minutes to go 37.2 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat instill water to that of the stream is 8 : 5. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 79.4 km upstream and 85.8 km downstream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Upstream speed** (U) = 37.2 km / (27/60) h = 82.67 kmph

Ratio **Boat** : **Stream** = 8 : 5 → **Upstream ratio** = 8 − 5 = 3 units; **Downstream ratio** = 8 + 5 = 13 units.

3 units = 82.66 kmph ⇒ 1 unit = 27.55 kmph ⇒ Downstream (13 units) = 358.22 kmph.

Total Time = (79.4 / 82.66) + (85.8 / 358.22) ≈ 0.96 + 0.24 = 1.2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bb5b09ee316b50a36e61f1327c45fac86ad93f23c873ed057a1340a6a4987b8.png] 

**Given:** Upstream Distance = 37.2 km, Time = 27 min, Ratio of Boat speed (v) to Stream speed (u) = 8 : 5.

**Formula:** Speed = Distance ÷ Time | Upstream Speed (U) = v − u | Downstream Speed (D) = v + u.

⇒ U = 37.2 ÷ (27/60) = (37.2 × 60) ÷ 27 = 2232 ÷ 27 = 82.666... kmph.

⇒ Let v = 8x and u = 5x. Then U = 8x − 5x = 3x.

⇒ 3x = 82.666... ⇒ x = 27.555... kmph.

⇒ Downstream Speed (D) = 8x + 5x = 13x = 13 × 27.555... = 358.222... kmph.

⇒ Time for 79.4 km upstream = 79.4 ÷ 82.666... = 0.9605 hours.

⇒ Time for 85.8 km downstream = 85.8 ÷ 358.222... = 0.2395 hours.

⇒ Total Time = 0.9605 + 0.2395 = 1.2 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.2 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Water

Upstream speed is the difference (v − u) and Downstream speed is the sum (v + u) of the boat and stream speeds.

Conversion of Time

To convert minutes to hours, divide by 60. To calculate speed in kmph, distance in km must be divided by time in hours.

Boat Speed Calculation

Speed of boat in still water (v) = (Downstream + Upstream) ÷ 2 and Stream speed (u) = (Downstream − Upstream) ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: A motorist covers a distance of 30 km in 50 minutes by moving at a speed of x km/hr for the first 13 minutes, then moving at the speed of 2x km/hr for the next 25 minutes and then again moving at the speed of x km/hr for the rest of the journey. The value of x is equal to:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time = 50 minutes. Breakdown: 13 mins (x), 25 mins (2x), and remaining (50 − 13 − 25) = 12 mins (x).

Total **Equivalent Time** at speed x = 13 + (25 × 2) + 12 = 13 + 50 + 12 = 75 minutes.

Distance = Speed × Time ⇒ 30 km = x × (75/60) hours.

x = (30 × 60) ÷ 75 = 1800 ÷ 75 = 24 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39eab6c88357c4165bde0d3619593a7fd81ed9a3a2ae66657e3ffba47d147a91.png] 

**Given:** Total Distance = 30 km, Total Time = 50 min.

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Third part time = 50 − (13 + 25) = 12 minutes.

⇒ Distance₁ = x × (13/60) km

⇒ Distance₂ = 2x × (25/60) km

⇒ Distance₃ = x × (12/60) km

⇒ Total Distance = (13x/60) + (50x/60) + (12x/60) = 30

⇒ 75x/60 = 30

⇒ 5x/4 = 30

⇒ 5x = 120

⇒ x = 24 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 24 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. In this case, 30 km ÷ (50/60) hours = 36 km/hr.

Unit Conversion

To convert **minutes to hours**, divide by 60. To convert **km/hr to m/s**, multiply by 5/18.

Distance with Variable Speeds

Total Distance = (S₁ × T₁) + (S₂ × T₂) + ... + (Sₙ × Tₙ), ensuring all units are consistent.</p

questions.question: A person drove at 23 km/hr for 4.5 hours, then increased his speed by 11 km/hr, and reached the destination in another hour. Find the average speed (in km/hr) of the person during the entire journey.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Initial Speed** = 23 km/hr for 4.5 hours.

**Increased Speed** = 23 + 11 = 34 km/hr for 1 hour.

**Average Speed** = (Total Distance) ÷ (Total Time)

**Average Speed** = [(23 × 4.5) + (34 × 1)] ÷ (4.5 + 1) = (103.5 + 34) ÷ 5.5 = 137.5 ÷ 5.5 = 25 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 25 km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d25599f8b4d7b563a8782ae98ee5b77d9a266c95fbb9218b58dd4e73d2a5327.png] 

**Given:**

**Speed₁** = 23 km/hr, **Time₁** = 4.5 hr

**Speed₂** = 23 + 11 = 34 km/hr, **Time₂** = 1 hr

**Formula Used:**

**Average Speed** = (D₁ + D₂) ÷ (T₁ + T₂)

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Distance₁** = 23 × 4.5 = 103.5 km

⇒ **Distance₂** = 34 × 1 = 34 km

⇒ **Total Distance** = 103.5 + 34 = 137.5 km

⇒ **Total Time** = 4.5 + 1 = 5.5 hr

⇒ **Average Speed** = 137.5 ÷ 5.5

⇒ **Average Speed** = 25 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 25 km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

**Average Speed (Equal Distances)**

When a person travels equal distances at speeds **x** and **y**, the average speed is 2xy ÷ (x + y).

**Relative Speed**

If two objects move in the **same direction**, relative speed = s₁ − s₂. In **opposite directions**, relative speed = s₁ + s₂.

**Unit Conversion**

To convert **km/hr** to **m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s** to **km/hr**, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: While covering a distance of 39 km, a man noticed that after cycling for 5 hours 5 minutes, the distance covered by him was dfrac{5}{4} of the remaining distance. What was his speed (in km/hr, rounded off to one decimal place)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 39 km. Ratio of **Covered Distance** to **Remaining Distance** = 5 : 4.

Total units = 5 + 4 = 9 units → 39 km. Covered distance = (5/9) × 39 = 21.666 km.

Time taken = 5 hours 5 minutes = 5 + 5/60 = 5 + 1/12 = 61/12 hours.

Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 21.666 ÷ (61/12) ≈ 4.26 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.3 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total distance = 39 km, Time = 5 hours 5 minutes, Covered distance = 5/4 × Remaining distance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/450114f4a45739d35658be28c44d187b282e7302f8f88c9dda681b7269d304cf.png] 

Let the remaining distance be x km.

⇒ Covered distance = 5x/4 km.

⇒ Total Distance = 5x/4 + x = 9x/4

⇒ 9x/4 = 39

⇒ x = (39 × 4) ÷ 9 = 156/9 = 52/3 km.

⇒ Covered Distance = 39 − 52/3 = (117 − 52)/3 = 65/3 km.

⇒ Time = 5 hours + 5/60 hours = 305/60 = 61/12 hours.

⇒ Speed = Distance ÷ Time = (65/3) ÷ (61/12) = (65/3) × (12/61) = 260/61 km/hr.

⇒ Speed ≈ 4.262 km/hr ≈ 4.3 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.3 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed, Distance, and Time Relationship

The basic formula is Speed = Distance ÷ Time. Ensure all units are consistent (e.g., km and hours) before calculation.

Unit Conversion

To convert minutes to hours, divide by 60. To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18.

Rounding Off Rules

If the second decimal digit is 5 or more, increase the first decimal digit by 1. Here, 4.26 becomes 4.3.</p

questions.question: A person drove at 77 km/hr for 3.5 hours, then increased his speed by 9 km/hr, and reached the destination in another hour. Find the average speed (in km/hr) of the person during the entire journey.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ 
**Initial speed** = 77 km/hr for 3.5 hours.
 
**New speed** = 77 + 9 = 86 km/hr for 1 hour.
 
**Deviation method**: Taking 77 as base average speed.
 
**Net deviation** = (86 − 77) × 1 hour = +9 km.
 
**Average increase** = 9 ÷ (3.5 + 1) = 9 ÷ 4.5 = 2 km/hr.
 
**Final average speed** = 77 + 2 = 79 km/hr.
 
**∴ The correct answer is 79 km/hr.**
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffa9e881c5da9e7747f92b3a12c8ce0d85ecbc8733f6457bf2d988734ba149b6.png] 
**Given:**
 
**Speed 1 (S₁)** = 77 km/hr | **Time 1 (T₁)** = 3.5 hours
 
**Speed 2 (S₂)** = 77 + 9 = 86 km/hr | **Time 2 (T₂)** = 1 hour
 
**Formula Used:**
 
**Average Speed** = Total Distance ÷ Total Time
 
**Calculations:**
 
⇒ Distance 1 = 77 × 3.5 = 269.5 km
 
⇒ Distance 2 = 86 × 1 = 86 km
 
⇒ Total Distance = 269.5 + 86 = 355.5 km
 
⇒ Total Time = 3.5 + 1 = 4.5 hours
 
⇒ Average Speed = 355.5 ÷ 4.5
 
⇒ Average Speed = 3555 ÷ 45 = 79 km/hr
 
**∴ The correct answer is 79 km/hr.**
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
 
Weighted Average Speed
 
When different speeds are maintained for different durations, Average Speed = (S₁T₁ + S₂T₂) ÷ (T₁ + T₂).
 
Equal Distance Formula
 
If two equal distances are covered at speeds S₁ and S₂, Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).
 
Relative Speed
 
Same direction speed = S₁ − S₂; Opposite direction speed = S₁ + S₂.</p
